No, XL plants ship Standard only, so Express isn't available for a 5 ft bird of paradise. If the listing marks it as XL (usually anything over 4 ft), it adds a **$20** handling fee. Standard shipping is $7.95, or free on orders of $75+ after discounts and before tax.

Standard delivery takes **2-3 business days** in Zone 1 (under 300 miles from the nearest greenhouse), **3-5** in Zone 2 (300-1,000 miles), and **5-8** in Zone 3 (over 1,000 miles, remote and island addresses). Live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only, so orders placed after 12 noon Wednesday ship the following Monday.
